images.title: Weekday sleep and holiday sleep on a strip
images.purpose: Before and after: a weekday strip with 16 boxes of sleep and a holiday strip with 20, so 4 more boxes.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two long strips of 48 boxes, one above the other and aligned box by box.
images.exact_structure: Two horizontal strips of 48 equal boxes each, one above the other, aligned box by box, boxes numbered left to right from 1 (just after midnight) to 48 with no numbers shown. Top strip, labelled weekday at its left: boxes 1 to 12 and 45 to 48 filled teal (#0072B2), 16 boxes; all others white. Bottom strip, labelled holiday at its left: boxes 1 to 12 and 45 to 48 filled teal, and boxes 13 to 16 filled reddish purple (#CC79A7), 20 sleep boxes; all others white. A small bracket under boxes 13 to 16 of the bottom strip is tagged 4 more boxes. Right of the top strip: 16 boxes = 8 h; right of the bottom strip: 20 boxes = 10 h.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: On a strip, every 2 boxes is 1 hour, so 2 more hours of sleep is 4 more boxes.
images.description: Before and after: a weekday strip with 16 boxes of sleep and a holiday strip with 20, so 4 more boxes.
images.context: Each box is 30 minutes; sleep 8 hours on a weekday and 10 hours on a holiday.

image_decisions.why: Two aligned strips make the comparison of the student's own days countable.
